description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on resident care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. We are seeking a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring superior resident outcomes, financial stability, and regulatory adherence. You will foster a positive work culture, mentor a talented team, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the resident experience.This full-time position comes with a competitive annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, reflecting your expertise and leadership. If you are a results-oriented LNHA looking for a challenging yet rewarding role, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, financial performance, and resident care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role is responsible for the timely and accurate completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring compliance with all federal and state regulations and optimizing resident care plans.

As an RN MDS Coordinator, you will play a crucial part in the interdisciplinary team, contributing to comprehensive care planning and accurate reimbursement. This is a full-time opportunity offering a competitive salary range and a chance to make a significant impact on resident outcomes.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 and strong understanding of federal and state regulations
Excellent assessment, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $65,000 to $75,000 per year, based on experience.
